title: Create gaming application with interactive gameplay

requirements.text: Create a gaming application with interactive gameplay mechanics

quotes: I want to Create app for gaming

acceptanceCriteria: User can start and play a game
Game state is managed and persisted in the backend

requirements.text: Implement a visually engaging game interface with smooth animations and responsive controls
acceptanceCriteria: Visual feedback is provided for user actions

requirements.text: Store and retrieve game scores or progress in the backend
acceptanceCriteria: Game scores are persisted across sessions
User can view their game history or high scores
Backend provides queries for retrieving game data

requirements.text: Design a creative and cohesive visual theme for the gaming app using bold, vibrant colors (avoiding blue and purple unless specifically needed), dynamic typography, and a modern gaming aesthetic that feels energetic and immersive
acceptanceCriteria: Visual theme is consistently applied across all screens
Color palette is vibrant and suitable for gaming
Typography and layout support an engaging user experience

constraints: Use React with TypeScript for frontend implementation
Use Motoko for backend logic in a single-actor architecture
Do not modify immutable frontend paths including useInternetIdentity hooks and UI components
nonGoals: Integration with external gaming platforms or APIs
Mobile-specific gaming controls or native app deployment

required: Vibrant gaming hero banner with abstract geometric patterns and energetic colors (hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
Game controller icon in a modern flat style (controller-icon.dim_128x128.png)
